title: Sec Considerations repeats receiptSharing MUST NOT
description: The Read Receipt Privacy paragraph in Security Considerations (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md lines ~1440-1441) states: 'When PresenceStatus.receiptSharing is false, the server MUST NOT invoke Peer/receipt on behalf of the account.' This is a verbatim restatement of the normative MUST NOT already in the PresenceStatus.receiptSharing field definition (~line 785): 'The server MUST NOT invoke Peer/receipt with a readAt value on behalf of this account.' The Security section adds only one non-redundant sentence (the rationale: 'This prevents a remote peer from inferring when the owner reads messages.'). Suggested improvement: collapse the Security section paragraph to just the rationale and cross-reference, e.g. 'When receiptSharing is false (see {{presence-status}} and {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}), outbound Peer/receipt calls are suppressed invisibly to the sender, preventing a remote peer from inferring when the owner reads messages.' Remove the repeated normative MUST NOT from the security section.
close_reason: Fixed: Security section now cross-references rather than restating MUST NOT (chat-00.md:1440)
